note: PASSIVE registry (v2 plan T9 / CM2). Fields are IDs, file paths, human titles, and human-readable trigger text ONLY. The skeleton's phase sequencing (Sequential Execution + the Phase 0 UI/DX scope detection) is the ONLY place that decides WHEN to read a section — Phase 2 and Phase 2.5 are conditional and their sections must NOT be read when their scope is absent; required-reads live in the E2E fixtures. No machine predicate here — see docs/designs/v2_PLAN.md:663.

sections.title: Phase 1: CEO review (strategy & scope) — override rules, dual voices, required outputs
sections.trigger: starting Phase 1 (CEO review — always runs, after the Phase 0.5 preflight)

sections.title: Phase 2: design review — override rules, dual voices, 7-pass checklist
sections.trigger: starting Phase 2 (design review — ONLY if UI scope was detected in Phase 0; skip the read entirely otherwise)

sections.title: Phase 3: eng review + dual voices — override rules, test review, required outputs
sections.trigger: starting Phase 3 (eng review — always runs, after all earlier applicable phases have closed)

sections.title: Phase 2.5: DX review — override rules, dual voices, 8-dimension scorecard
sections.trigger: starting Phase 2.5 (DX review — ONLY if developer-facing scope was detected in Phase 0; skip the read entirely otherwise)

sections.title: Close the current review phase — current readback, reconciliation and visible completion
sections.trigger: closing a review phase, after its reviews finish and before announcing completion or loading the next phase (read afresh at each exit)

sections.title: Phase 4: Implementation Tasks aggregator (builds $AGGREGATED_TASKS for the gate)
sections.trigger: presenting the Final Approval Gate (Phase 4) — the aggregator computes $AGGREGATED_TASKS that the gate message substitutes
